source.title: STM32Trust
source.applicability: Comprehensive security ecosystem for STM32 microcontrollers, including secure boot, secure firmware updates, trusted execution environment, and hardware-based security features to establish chain of trust from immutable hardware elements

passages.text: STM32Trust provides developers with a robust, multilevel strategy to enhance security in their new product designs. With a set of 12 security functions offering hardware, software, and design services from ST and third parties

1. Secure boot


 
 Ability to ensure the authenticity and integrity of an application that runs inside a device.
